test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn Graph objects for structural equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn Graph objects for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic checking structural equivalence regardless of node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn Graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt and verify it matches the expected graph structure
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn Graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt and verify the output format matches expected lines
test_gtn_loadsave: test saving and loading a gtn Graph using gtn.save and gtn.load and verify the round-trip preserves graph equality
